book.name: 1Timoteo
book.title: 1Timoteo Timoteo veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa Ibiꞌa

content: Eꞌanoꞌo e ibite geno ḡoere ꞌahi inare ḡaꞌohe. Vaze niduꞌa urateꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa Badiꞌa mazao umidoꞌi, zu zeḡe veize kuranoꞌi, zu vaze ꞌahogaꞌahoga veize kuranoꞌi, ebu zeḡe niduꞌa veize Badiꞌa mazao manoḡa tauḡi roꞌi.
Nize boro azaḡa niduꞌa ebu kini veize kuranoꞌi. ꞌOugine, eme Badiꞌa hube hune gubaneꞌenaꞌa zu zaḡozaḡe haḡaeꞌenaꞌa, zama roḡeḡa huneo sifu radiꞌuma.
ꞌOuge kurauꞌetaꞌaꞌe manoḡa, zu emeḡe ḡabofeꞌeteꞌe Badiꞌaḡa matuꞌohauꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa.
Badiꞌaꞌe vaze niduꞌa ḡabone hidoga zu zeꞌe ihore huga ederadu mae ḡihinoga urateꞌohe.
Badiꞌaꞌe tibuhuga, ebu Badiꞌa zu vaze boꞌaḡano nema vazeḡa zuni tibuhuga. Aniꞌe vaze, Keriso Iesu.
Aniꞌa vaze niduꞌa haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo bohaze buzoga veize ane bare dibuꞌiro. Ebu ani Badiꞌaꞌa ohoniroteꞌe madaḡano ꞌouge haḡadu Badiꞌaꞌa vaze ḡaboziteꞌe rae fureniro.

Hari manoḡa eꞌe rae furenifine, Badiꞌaꞌa eꞌe haramo vazeḡano zu apostolo vazeḡano ohohiro. Ebu Iuda mene azaḡa mazao hari manoḡa huga ihozadu ze Iesu mazao fioga veize, e zeḡe ihore vazeḡano ohohiro. E huga ḡoereꞌohe zu mene ḡurireꞌohe.
E ohozeohozeꞌa haba niduꞌa zamaḡano Badiꞌa mazao kuranoga urateꞌohe. Ebu ze mene maḡuneꞌenaꞌa, mene roteteꞌenaꞌa, zu zaḡozaḡe radiuꞌenaꞌa, ꞌevoreze mae ḡihinadu kuranoga e urateꞌohe.
Ebu roḡaeroḡae zuni dabua idaidaḡa faine vidanoga, iguze mene nunufe siꞌoga, ebu hadi naeḡa boro zu naeḡa boro dabuaḡa mene vidanoga urateꞌohe.
U ze haḡai manoḡa haḡadu ze zeḡeꞌa bare Badiꞌa gubaneꞌeteꞌe roḡaeḡa rae furenoga urateꞌohe.
Roḡaeꞌe ihore azaḡa ꞌuꞌuḡano ḡoereze niduꞌa egohanadu sifu edeḡa meꞌuma.
E roḡaeꞌa ohoze ihozoga zu ibitozoga mene idaḡa raꞌohe. Ze sifu radiꞌuma.
Mazaḡa Adamuꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa ibite haḡairo ebu hena Eva haḡairo.
Sataniꞌa Adamu mene soꞌoniro, rehano Eva soꞌonadu aniꞌa haḡai sauꞌa haḡairo.
Rehano roḡaeꞌa iḡaiḡa Iesu mazao fieꞌenaꞌa, vaze zamare borofine ebu zaḡozaḡeꞌenaꞌa faine radiune, zeꞌa ene fureneꞌeteꞌeanoꞌo
